description: Get a venue's hours, address, map, phone, booking and links by name or slug, e.g. venue="Acme Bistro". It also holds cuisine, attributes, menu_summary and capabilities (the other venue_* tools that answer for it); hours_summary is ready to quote.

city.description: Disambiguate a name by city (call list_cities); ignored for a slug.

venue.description: Venue name or slug; call search_venues to discover one.

name: venue_profile
